title: How much exercise do adults need?

publish.title: How much exercise do adults need? The CDC numbers
publish.description: Weekly activity guidance for adults, from the CDC.

scenes.headline: How much exercise do adults need?
scenes.narration: The CDC has a clear answer for adults. Here are the numbers.

scenes.headline: Moderate activity
scenes.narration: Adults need at least one hundred fifty minutes of moderate-intensity activity a week, such as brisk walking, thirty minutes a day, five days a week.

scenes.headline: Or vigorous activity
scenes.narration: Or seventy-five minutes of vigorous activity, such as jogging or running, or an equivalent mix of the two.

scenes.headline: Plus strength
scenes.narration: On top of that, adults need muscle-strengthening activities on two or more days a week.

scenes.headline: Work every major muscle group
scenes.narration: Those activities should work all the major muscle groups: legs and hips, back and abdomen, chest, shoulders and arms.

scenes.headline: Some is better than none
scenes.narration: If you are starting from nothing, any activity helps. Build up gradually, and ask a professional if you are unsure.
